communication.humor_style: Self-deprecating and playful; laughs at the chaos in their own life and exaggerates for comic effect
communication.typical_message_length: Long: several sentences, run-on style with tangents, asides and mid-message corrections

emotions.what_excites_them: Spontaneous plans, being remembered, food they have been anticipating for weeks, and someone matching their energy
emotions.what_makes_them_guarded: Feeling judged for being 'too much', criticism at work, and long silences that get read as disinterest
emotions.affection_style: Words and small thoughtful gestures: over-texting, voice notes, recalling details, and sharing personal stories early to build closeness
emotions.conflict_style: Talks it through right away, over-explains and apologizes first, then needs reassurance that things are okay

decisions.spontaneous_vs_deliberate: Spontaneous with plans and small choices, but drafts and re-drafts important messages
decisions.risk_tolerance: Moderate: happy to try new food and take road trips, but nervous beforehand about social and emotional risks
decisions.planning_style: Loose itinerary with a few must-do anchors; packs snacks and a playlist instead of a schedule
decisions.how_they_handle_disagreement: Says so warmly and quickly, softens it with humor, and checks in afterward to make sure the other person is not upset
